anomalies: celeste:achievements:real-gamer and celeste:achievements:1up — neither achievement has a location in any manifested source, so the spine emits no step for either and this checklist is the only place they are tracked. "Real Gamer" (Complete Celeste for PICO-8) and "1UP!" (Get a 1UP) need a source added through the sources pass before the route can place them. The rows themselves are not flagged: their name and requirement are reproduced exactly from src-ink-achievements and are not in doubt — only where they are earned is unknown.

celeste:achievements:thanks-for-playing is the only achievement covering more than one chapter of work — "Complete all C-Sides" pays out once for all eight. Every other clear and heart achievement is one-to-one with a cell of the Sides & Hearts matrix.
